text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn. The season when cooking-loving 
Umamusume put their culinary skills on 
full display...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make a big omelet rice~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll wrap it all up with lots of happiness 
and bake it, making everyone feel buono~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I plan to make strudel— a pastry baked 
with rolled apples and nuts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, the most important part of a 
strudel is the whipped cream...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not too sweet, not too firm... In order to 
create the perfect, exquisite 
melt-in-the-mouth texture, it must be 
mixed with pinpoint precision...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make candied chestnuts...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to recreate a recipe that one of 
my fans taught me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best following the recipe so it 
turns out delicious!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's simmering slowly over low heat, so 
please wait just a little longer~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I went and checked on the kitchen~. 
Everything looked so tasty~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... But are you sure it's okay? To 
entrust me with such a glorious role as 
"taste-tester"?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Spe. They believed in us and entrusted 
this to our hands.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, all we can do is give 
everything we have to live up to those 
expectations...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
! You're right! Let's eat with all our 
might and live up to expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Autumn. It is also the season when 
food-loving Umamusume test the absolute 
limits of their stomachs...
